sections.title: Upcoming shows
sections.sql: select code,artist,local_start,timezone,venue,status,owner from booking_desk where status in ('hold','confirmed') order by starts_at

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from findings order by rule,record

sections.title: Each show, its own currency
sections.sql: select code,artist,promoter,currency,fee_cents,received_cents,balance_cents,deposit_outstanding_cents from booking_desk where status<>'cancelled' order by starts_at

sections.title: Open preparation
sections.sql: select code,booking,artist,category,due_on,owner from preparation_queue where completed_on is null order by due_on
